sources.title: SQLite expression indexes
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: LSM-tree：寫入放大與 compaction 合併
related.titleEn: LSM trees: write amplification and compaction merges
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：對 abs(amount) 建索引，測試等價但不同語法是否獲得相同計畫。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Index abs(amount) and test whether mathematically equivalent syntax yields the same plan. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 追蹤同一 key 跨 SSTable 的版本，合併時只保留符合快照政策的最新值。
related.differenceEn: Trace key versions across SSTables and merge according to snapshot retention policy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: SQLite expression index 的比對依運算式形式，不承諾一般代數等價辨識；函數亦須滿足規定。 教學基準：2/5*100 = 40 matching percent；第二檢核：80*80 = 6400 squared threshold。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

LSM 以批次有序檔降低隨機寫入，後續 compaction 會重寫資料；tombstone 刪除也有保存條件。 教學基準：100*3+200+300 = 800 physical MiB written；第二檢核：800/300 = 2.666666667 write amplification。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: SQLite matches expression-index forms without general algebraic equivalence recognition; functions must meet engine requirements. Teaching baseline: 2/5*100 = 40 matching percent; second check: 80*80 = 6400 squared threshold. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

LSM trees batch sorted writes but compaction rewrites data; tombstone removal also requires retention conditions. Teaching baseline: 100*3+200+300 = 800 physical MiB written; second check: 800/300 = 2.666666667 write amplification. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 透過兩區分割情境說明一致讀取與所有請求成功無法同時承諾。
related.differenceEn: Use a two-region partition to expose conflicting promises of consistent reads and universal success.

CAP 的 availability 是每個對非故障節點的請求都得到回應的形式條件；不是年度 uptime 百分比。 教學基準：1-0 = 1 version gap；第二檢核：2-1 = 1 isolated peer count。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Teaching baseline: 2/5*100 = 40 matching percent; second check: 80*80 = 6400 squared threshold. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
